anita: quick FYI  nightly scanner bubbled up a couple broken refs in the runtime "kv cache" examples (small low-priority cleanup). anyone on docs can grab? i can if no one else. :wave:
tom: can you drop the scan lines?
anita: sure: `https://internal.redwood/runtime/kv-cache#old-prefetch` and `https://cdn.redwood/old-assets/kv-cache-v1.png`
sara: looks like the old heading id plus a deprecated CDN path. low-effort. tom/kevin any preference who picks?
tom: i'll take the fragment update and update the snippet blocks. i'll swap to `#kv-prefetching` which matches the current heading. opening a tiny PR.
kevin: i'll rehost the diagram under `/docs-static` and add a 301 from the old CDN path. will paste the new link in the PR comments when done.
deploy-bot: link-scan: LS-2026-900 created  assigned=#docs severity=low ticket=DOCS-999
anita: thanks both. tom  ping me for a quick preview review. kevin  post the hosted url here when it's available.
tom: PR opened: `fix/docs/kvcache-308765`  replaces fragment and updates example snippet. cc @sara @anita for review.
kevin: uploaded `https://cdn.redwood/docs-static/kv-cache-v2.png` and configured redirect. posted url in PR comment.
sara: preview verified on staging  image loads and anchor jump works. small nit: add a changelog line "docs: kv-cache anchor + asset fix" so we have traceability.
tom: added changelog and linked backlog card CARD-741. merging after CI passes.
anita: lovely. closing loop  thanks folks! :white_check_mark:
